sources.snippet: Bidirectional encoder representations from transformers (BERT) is a language model introduced in October 2018 by researchers at Google. [2][3] It learns to represent text as a sequence of vectors using self-supervised learning. It uses the encoder-only transformer architecture. BERT dramatically improved the state of the art for large language models. As of 2026, BERT is a common ...
